hints: Consider the items one at a time. For a given remaining capacity, what are the two choices?
Take the item, if it fits, and solve the rest with less capacity; or skip it and solve the rest with the same capacity. Take the better.
That is a table over (items considered, capacity used), filled one item at a time - and each row needs only the row above it.
Rolled into one row, the inner loop must run downwards over the capacities, or an item gets taken more than once.
